finder.signing_required: This build cannot load the Finder extension yet. Continue with full local synchronization.
finder.configuration_incomplete: Finder account storage is not configured in this build. Full local synchronization is available.
finder.provider_unavailable: macOS cannot currently discover the Finder provider. Full local synchronization is available.
finder.component_missing: The Finder component is not included in this build. Full local synchronization is available.
finder.setupDescription: Files appear in Finder and download when opened. Local changes upload to the cloud. Finder manages the local folder. Conflicts can require manual resolution.
finder.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from Finder? Synchronization stops; downloaded and unsynced files are preserved by macOS. Cloud files are not deleted.
finder.preserved: Drive removed. Local files preserved at {{path}}.
finder.retryRequested: Retry requested. Check Finder for transfer progress or remaining errors.
finder.disabled: Enable Cloudreve Finder Preview in System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions. Then refresh this page.
finder.disconnected: This drive is disconnected. Retry the connection, or reauthorize if the account has expired.
finder.keychainUnavailable: Account credentials are unavailable. Unlock the login Keychain and allow Cloudreve access, then refresh.
finder.legacyIdentity: This older drive has no stored account identity for safe reauthorization. Preserve local files by removing the drive, then add it again.
finder.registered: Extension enabled and account record accessible. This does not confirm that all files are synchronized.
finder.host_error: Cannot contact the Finder component. Check its status in Settings and retry.
